caseName: Minnesota Public Interest Research Group v. Secretary of Agriculture
caseNameFull: Minnesota Public Interest Research Group v. Secretary of Agriculture

opinions.text:
Application to recall and stay mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit, presented to Mr. Justice Blackmun, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Motion to dispense with printing appendix to petition for certiorari granted.

Mr. Justice Brennan would grant the application. Mr. Justice Blackmun took no part in the consideration or decision of this application and motion.
